structured.answer: Yeah, a קרן כספית יומית looks right for money I might need soon: it's low risk, the money comes back any trading day and it says about 3.25% a year against 0% in my עו"ש. But the page never tells me what the fee actually is in numbers, so I don't know what I'd really pay.

stuck.why: I expected a fee number. Every row just says 'אין תקרה בחוק' plus codes, so there's no percent and no shekels
Not sure if that's what the fund pays me or just the central bank rate. The small line under the box I didn't read
Wall of text full of underlined words I don't know. I skimmed it and lost the thread
There's no next step, no fund names and nothing to press to start
